title: Research: certify a class-C V2 stabilizer quotient
body:
## Summary

This contributes a bounded route-B result to [Discussion #2954](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2954). It certifies a stabilizer-subgroup orbit quotient for the `(5,6,4,5)` ordering of config `6554 = (6,5,5,4)` and one first-flat orbit.

The package checks the 12 pinned label permutations on all of `F_2^9`, their induced permutations of the 18,100 typed rows in `data88.txt`, and 12 exact invertible rational `8 x 8` witnesses carrying every listed line or plane direction to its image. For the selected first-flat orbit, it exhaustively partitions the 776,806 distinct six-flat root masks into 47,850 subgroup orbits, a factor `776806/47850 = 16.234190177638x` reduction in the V2 candidate list. The largest orbit contains 32 masks.

The proof is equivariance: a subgroup fixing V1 maps V2, its label cover, the finite Off-direction set, and the corresponding real direction spans bijectively. Therefore every V2 in a subgroup orbit has the same checker outcome and one representative suffices. The least-mask convention is used for this witness; integration with all existing union-find V1 representatives remains open.

## Verification

- `python3 -B research/k2-class-c-stabilizer-orbit-quotient/verify.py` — PASS under CPython 3.14, 178.459 seconds; exact source checks, rational matrix checks, exhaustive RREF/mask enumeration, orbit partition and rejecting controls.
- `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/k2-class-c-stabilizer-orbit-quotient --check-only` — PASS.
- `python3 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/k2-class-c-stabilizer-orbit-quotient` — PASS for commit `ba3cfcea4bdc485e663a4a48f91b66da4dbc01ed`.

The registered replay specifies Python 3.12. This container has only Python 3.14, so the repository wrapper declined the full registered run with “run replay with Python 3.12”; the verifier itself completed directly under 3.14. It uses only the standard library.

## Scope and remaining work

The result assumes the pinned source's statement that `data88.txt` is complete for `|Off(h)| <= 88`. The count applies to one first-flat orbit, not all V1 orbits or all configs. No `s4z` pair closure was run, no row is killed, and no RRC premise is checked. No supplier, general lower bound, or `kappa` change is claimed; selected `kappa` remains `0.001672660197076918`.

Merged PRs [#2975](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2975) and [#3000](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3000) improve other stages. Merged [#3315](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3315) audits the config census; open [#3334](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3334) establishes the same-threshold dominance reduction to `6554@T7` for the hard rows but no geometric span pass. This PR covers the separate V2 stabilizer quotient. The open Issue #913 is editorial and unrelated.

The changed-scope task metadata, source pins, exact matrix witnesses, attribution and open questions are in `research/k2-class-c-stabilizer-orbit-quotient/`. The 5 MB `data88.txt` input is copied unchanged and credited in `NOTICE.md`. Prepared by OpenAI Codex with substantial AI assistance; no independent human proof review is claimed.
